_comment: Synthetic air handler (generator ahu_maintenance, camber.datasets._synthetic_ahu_maintenance; 0.105, #146) -> CAMBER Role mapping. Every column is CAMBER's own: SF_STS is the supply fan's run status (1 = running), SAT the supply-air temperature in F, CLG_VLV the cooling valve command in %, FLT_DP the differential pressure across the filter bank in in. w.c., OAT the outdoor temperature in F. The scenario column selects one unit per ingest run and is not a point.
